comments.body:
This is once again a dangerous situation because of NS upload only was not enabled. @smokkelaar now set NS to upload only and it works now.
@MilosKozak we **really** need to fix this, either by completely disabling the option to download from NS, or by not allowing NS to change the truth (= create/overwrite treatments in the present). Only the pump driver should be able to create treatments in the present.

Another option would be to allow to backfill from NS once on intial setup, when no data is present yet. Anyway in the current form it is dangerous. It frequently causes all kinds of problems and it should be removed ASAP.
this will be resolved by new NSClient
